The house on the hill

A family home that
became a hideaway

Eminence Shire Ella is a small, family-run hillside hotel in Wemullahena — a five-minute (steep) walk above the noise of Ella's main street. Guests are welcomed with hot Ceylon tea on the terrace and looked after by Aku and his family, who make the breakfasts, arrange the tuk-tuks and, if you ask, teach you to cook a four-curry Sri Lankan dinner.

Because there are only three rooms, nothing here feels like a hotel. Breakfast is carried to the table outside your door, the laundry comes back folded, the tea keeps arriving all afternoon — and the valley in front of you does the rest.

Finding us

Wemullahena,
Ella 90090

Off the main street and up a short, steep lane — five walking minutes from Ella town and the railway station. Tuk-tuks can make most of the climb; tell the host your arrival time and he will meet you at the bottom.
